theme: A wide-open Saturday with two things quietly on the clock.
greeting: No meetings today, Dan — a rare unbroken stretch. Two items want it, though: a GitHub token that lapses tomorrow and the December-trip call ahead of your 9 AM Sunday review.

needsAttention.title: Renew your GitHub deploy token
needsAttention.detail: A GitHub notice in your inbox says the fine-grained token briefings-deploy-3 expires in about a day — it's what publishes this brief, so renew it before it lapses.

needsAttention.title: Make the December-break call
needsAttention.detail: Your board task to shortlist the December trip has sat since Sep 30. Six people over the holidays, leaving Dec 13 — inventory thins every day. Pick domestic vs. international and book.

needsAttention.title: Walk into the Sunday review decided
needsAttention.detail: You and Mike meet at 9 AM to triage the board. Arrive with the trip direction chosen; the term-life quotes and the Portland order are the other two overdue items that will come up.

acts.line: The calendar is completely clear — not a single meeting on the day.
The girls are with Jen through the 14th, so the quiet stretch is yours to spend.
Tomorrow opens with the 9 AM board review — a few minutes on the board tonight makes it quick.
